Above: At the home UKWAL match at Sutton the Belles just missed stretching their win streak to cover two complete seasons.  Another four match points would have done it – but they don’t seem too downhearted as they now look forward to 2007 and UKWAL Division Two.

From left to right – standing: Juliet Fielden, Katryna Euridge, Eva Massey, John Vernon, Sarah Gailey, Jayne Anderson, Chris Privett, Claire Robinson, Bob Bridges (Joint Team Manager), Cynthia James (Joint Team Manager), Rex Bale, Carl Lawton, Jennifer Culley, Tony Fairclough, Sarah Murphy, Derek Jones, Ray James. Happy with a seventh successive year in the medals at the National Road Relay.
